# Build How-To: "The Ghoul" Build (Bloodstained Revolvers & Rifles based on the Fallout Prime Series)

![Build How-To: `The Ghoul` Build (Bloodstained Revolvers & Rifles based on the Fallout Prime Series)](/uploads/337_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

I love the new **Fallout series**. All details, characters and stories simply fit perfectly into the Fallout world. And the success of the series confirms this. And this is precisely why many new players are now finding their way to Appalachia. 

Watch Fallout on Amazon Prime*

One of the best characters in the series is **"The Ghoul"** in my opinion. Since the first trailers were released, he has been the focus and fits perfectly into the series. The combination of wasteland hero and bounty hunter with the look of a cowboy makes him unique. And his choice of weapons further underlines the character. So I just had to make a build based on it.

### The Ghoul Revolver

![The Ghul Revolver (MTS255 Shotgun Revolver)](/uploads/nukaknights-post-build-ghul-revolver-reddit.jpg) 

According to various Internet discussions, the Ghoul's revolver is said to be a modified version of the MTs255 shotgun revolver. This can be found e.g. here on Reddit. Or on Wikipedia.

**This "The Ghoul" build plays an Impro Revolver and a Lever-Lever Rifle.** He plays **bloodstained** with a **focus on critical hits** to maximize the damage for both revolvers and rifles. The Impro Revolver is not as powerful as the series revolver, but it most closely reflects a wasteland revolver and can be played with a silencer, which is a big advantage. The underlever rifle is also not 1:1 to the ghoul's weapon, as he plays an underlever shotgun, but shotguns are not particularly ideal in Fallout 76 due to their short range. The lever rifle is also a common cowboy weapon and a good way to reflect the character. 

By combining the perks for rifle shooter and gunslinger, you can constantly switch between revolver and rifle depending on the situation and do optimal damage with both.

## Outfit & Look

The Ghoul Char wears the West Coast Dustcoat, which we currently get for free with Fallout 1st. Matching the West Coast cowboy hat, a blue scarf and the Vault 33 backpack to round off the reference to the series. Yes, actually Lucy is carrying the backpack. But I think the reference to the series fits and there is no saddlebag backpack in Fallout 76.

Unfortunately, there is no ghoul mask that you can wear with a cowboy hat. Therefore, the character unfortunately has to play as “smooth skin”. However, the game files actually contain the textures of a ghoul mask, so maybe it will actually come.

![Ghoul mask texture (unfortunately not currently in the game)](/uploads/nukaknights-post-build-ghul-mask.jpg) 

![The Ghoul Build](/uploads/fallout-76-2024-04-14-11-58-26.jpg)

## Equipment

![BE15cf Impro Revolver](/uploads/fallout-76-2024-04-14-12-12-24.jpg) 

The Impro Revolver is well suited for this build as it is the only revolver that can use a silencer. The improvised wasteland look also fits well. I play the Impro Revolver in Bloodstained with the 2nd effect "Bullets explode and cause 20% area damage" and the 3rd perk "+15% bonus V.A.T.S. critical charge". This combination allows for high base damage, as well as good additional damage from the explosion at a distance. The explosions of the bullets are always applied directly to the target, while a projectile can become weaker at a long distance. The 3rd perk is a good addition to the critical hit frequency
